title: DR1 lets you filter the dashboard to one notification status; the frontend has no status filter.

finding.frontend: The frontend filter panel has one keyword box and a Search button (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/template.njk:38-56). Status appears on every row as a tag but there is no way to filter on it, so finding the drafts among a page of submitted notifications means reading each card.
finding.prototype: DR1 gives status its own collapsible section in the filter panel, holding a select labelled "Status" with eight options: "Select one" and then Draft, Submitted, In progress, Approved, Action required, Rejected and Complete (app/views/dashboard.html:133-161).
finding.difference: Add a status select to the filter form and pass the chosen value through the list read. Two things have to land first: the list endpoint must accept a status filter, and the frontend must have statuses worth filtering by — today it knows only Draft, Submitted, Amending and Deleted, so five of DR1's seven options would return nothing.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a status control in the frontend dashboard's filter panel.

relatedTo.why: that one comes first: five of DR1's seven filter options name statuses the frontend cannot yet hold, so the filter is only useful once the statuses exist
